TEXT.English: +20% unit production, -20% research, +100% distance and city-count maintenance.
TEXT.French: +20% unit production, -20% research, +100% distance and city-count maintenance.
TEXT.German: +20% Einheitenproduktion, -20% Forschung, +100% entfernungs- und städtezahlabhängiger Unterhalt.
TEXT.Italian: +20% unit production, -20% research, +100% distance and city-count maintenance.
TEXT.Spanish: +20% unit production, -20% research, +100% distance and city-count maintenance.

TEXT.English: Capital buildings give +1 culture and +1 commerce each; capital world wonders give +1 happiness empire-wide, capped at +3. Enables inheritance events.
TEXT.French: Capital buildings give +1 culture and +1 commerce each; capital world wonders give +1 happiness empire-wide, capped at +3. Enables inheritance events.
TEXT.German: Hauptstadtgebäude geben je +1 Kultur und +1 Handel; Weltwunder der Hauptstadt geben reichsweit +1 Zufriedenheit, maximal +3. Ermöglicht Erbfolgeereignisse.
TEXT.Italian: Capital buildings give +1 culture and +1 commerce each; capital world wonders give +1 happiness empire-wide, capped at +3. Enables inheritance events.
TEXT.Spanish: Capital buildings give +1 culture and +1 commerce each; capital world wonders give +1 happiness empire-wide, capped at +3. Enables inheritance events.

TEXT.English: Assigned specialists except slaves consume 1 less food.
TEXT.French: Assigned specialists except slaves consume 1 less food.
TEXT.German: Zugewiesene Spezialisten außer Sklaven verbrauchen 1 Nahrung weniger.
TEXT.Italian: Assigned specialists except slaves consume 1 less food.
TEXT.Spanish: Assigned specialists except slaves consume 1 less food.

TEXT.English: +20% production and no war weariness, but -2 happiness in every city.
TEXT.French: +20% production and no war weariness, but -2 happiness in every city.
TEXT.German: +20% Produktion und keine Kriegsmüdigkeit, aber -2 Zufriedenheit in jeder Stadt.
TEXT.Italian: +20% production and no war weariness, but -2 happiness in every city.
TEXT.Spanish: +20% production and no war weariness, but -2 happiness in every city.

TEXT.English: +2 happiness in every city and +1 commerce per specialist. Other civics are decided by elections. No stability penalties from incompatible civics.
TEXT.French: +2 happiness in every city and +1 commerce per specialist. Other civics are decided by elections. No stability penalties from incompatible civics.
TEXT.German: +2 Zufriedenheit in jeder Stadt und +1 Handel je Spezialist. Andere Staatsformen werden durch Wahlen entschieden. Keine Stabilitätsmali durch unvereinbare Staatsformen.
TEXT.Italian: +2 happiness in every city and +1 commerce per specialist. Other civics are decided by elections. No stability penalties from incompatible civics.
TEXT.Spanish: +2 happiness in every city and +1 commerce per specialist. Other civics are decided by elections. No stability penalties from incompatible civics.

TEXT.English: +1 happiness from palaces and monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.French: +1 happiness from palaces and monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.German: +1 Zufriedenheit durch Paläste und Monumente, einschließlich einzigartiger Ersatzgebäude.
TEXT.Italian: +1 happiness from palaces and monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 happiness from palaces and monuments, including unique replacements.

TEXT.English: +15% land combat strength against barbarians and countries with a different or no state religion. State-religion buildings give +1 happiness; other religious buildings give -2 happiness.
TEXT.French: +15% land combat strength against barbarians and countries with a different or no state religion. State-religion buildings give +1 happiness; other religious buildings give -2 happiness.
TEXT.German: +15% Kampfstärke für Landeinheiten gegen Barbaren und Länder mit fremder oder keiner Staatsreligion. Gebäude der Staatsreligion geben +1 Zufriedenheit, andere religiöse Gebäude -2 Zufriedenheit.
TEXT.Italian: +15% land combat strength against barbarians and countries with a different or no state religion. State-religion buildings give +1 happiness; other religious buildings give -2 happiness.
TEXT.Spanish: +15% land combat strength against barbarians and countries with a different or no state religion. State-religion buildings give +1 happiness; other religious buildings give -2 happiness.

TEXT.English: +25% gold income and +50% trade-route commerce.
TEXT.French: +25% gold income and +50% trade-route commerce.
TEXT.German: +25% Goldeinnahmen und +50% Wirtschaftspunkte durch Handelsrouten.
TEXT.Italian: +25% gold income and +50% trade-route commerce.
TEXT.Spanish: +25% gold income and +50% trade-route commerce.

TEXT.English: +5 culture per city and +20% production. -5 happiness in cities with a foreign culture plurality.
TEXT.French: +5 culture per city and +20% production. -5 happiness in cities with a foreign culture plurality.
TEXT.German: +5 Kultur je Stadt und +20% Produktion. -5 Zufriedenheit in Städten mit vorherrschender fremder Kultur.
TEXT.Italian: +5 culture per city and +20% production. -5 happiness in cities with a foreign culture plurality.
TEXT.Spanish: +5 culture per city and +20% production. -5 happiness in cities with a foreign culture plurality.

TEXT.English: +2 happiness in every city and +10% commerce.
TEXT.French: +2 happiness in every city and +10% commerce.
TEXT.German: +2 Zufriedenheit in jeder Stadt und +10% Wirtschaftspunkte.
TEXT.Italian: +2 happiness in every city and +10% commerce.
TEXT.Spanish: +2 happiness in every city and +10% commerce.

TEXT.English: +2 health in every city. Cottage improvements do not grow. Cannot assign specialists.
TEXT.French: +2 health in every city. Cottage improvements do not grow. Cannot assign specialists.
TEXT.German: +2 Gesundheit in jeder Stadt. Hüttenverbesserungen wachsen nicht. Kann keine Spezialisten zuweisen.
TEXT.Italian: +2 health in every city. Cottage improvements do not grow. Cannot assign specialists.
TEXT.Spanish: +2 health in every city. Cottage improvements do not grow. Cannot assign specialists.

TEXT.English: Enables slave specialists. Enslave conquered peoples.
TEXT.French: Enables slave specialists. Enslave conquered peoples.
TEXT.German: Schaltet Sklavenspezialisten frei. Versklavt eroberte Völker.
TEXT.Italian: Enables slave specialists. Enslave conquered peoples.
TEXT.Spanish: Enables slave specialists. Enslave conquered peoples.

TEXT.English: +1 food from farms; workers build improvements 50% faster, and population can rush units.
TEXT.French: +1 food from farms; workers build improvements 50% faster, and population can rush units.
TEXT.German: +1 Nahrung durch Bauernhöfe; Bautrupps errichten Verbesserungen 50% schneller und Bevölkerung kann Einheiten beschleunigen.
TEXT.Italian: +1 food from farms; workers build improvements 50% faster, and population can rush units.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 food from farms; workers build improvements 50% faster, and population can rush units.

TEXT.English: +1 production from workshops, watermills and windmills; +1 food from farms; -10% commerce. No trade routes with Capitalists.
TEXT.French: +1 production from workshops, watermills and windmills; +1 food from farms; -10% commerce. No trade routes with Capitalists.
TEXT.German: +1 Produktion durch Werkstätten, Wasser- und Windmühlen; +1 Nahrung durch Bauernhöfe; -10% Wirtschaftspunkte. Keine Handelswege mit Kapitalisten.
TEXT.Italian: +1 production from workshops, watermills and windmills; +1 food from farms; -10% commerce. No trade routes with Capitalists.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 production from workshops, watermills and windmills; +1 food from farms; -10% commerce. No trade routes with Capitalists.

TEXT.English: +1 free specialist in every city; cottage improvements grow twice as fast. No trade routes with Communists.
TEXT.French: +1 free specialist in every city; cottage improvements grow twice as fast. No trade routes with Communists.
TEXT.German: +1 freier Spezialist in jeder Stadt; Hüttenverbesserungen wachsen doppelt so schnell. Keine Handelswege mit Kommunisten.
TEXT.Italian: +1 free specialist in every city; cottage improvements grow twice as fast. No trade routes with Communists.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 free specialist in every city; cottage improvements grow twice as fast. No trade routes with Communists.

TEXT.English: Melee units start with +2 experience; siege units have -20% combat strength.
TEXT.French: Melee units start with +2 experience; siege units have -20% combat strength.
TEXT.German: Nahkampfeinheiten starten mit +2 Erfahrung; Belagerungseinheiten haben -20% Kampfstärke.
TEXT.Italian: Melee units start with +2 experience; siege units have -20% combat strength.
TEXT.Spanish: Melee units start with +2 experience; siege units have -20% combat strength.

TEXT.English: +50% military ship production and +2 experience for newly trained military ships, including transports. Workboats receive neither bonus. Available to every civilization with Sailing.
TEXT.French: +50% à la production de navires militaires et +2 points d’expérience pour les nouveaux navires militaires, transports compris. Les bateaux de pêche ne reçoivent aucun de ces bonus. Accessible à toute civilisation connaissant la voile.
TEXT.German: +50% Produktion für Schiffe und +2XP für neu gebaute Schiffe. Mit Segeln für alle Zivilisationen verfügbar.
TEXT.Italian: +50% alla produzione e +2 esperienza per le nuove navi militari, inclusi i trasporti. Le barche da lavoro non ricevono questi bonus. Disponibile per tutte le civiltà con la Vela.
TEXT.Spanish: +50% a la producción y +2 de experiencia para los nuevos barcos militares, incluidos los transportes. Los barcos de trabajo no reciben estas bonificaciones. Disponible para todas las civilizaciones con Navegación a vela.

TEXT.English: +5% land military unit production per Farm actually worked by the producing city. Includes siege units; excludes civilian units and ships. Six worked Farms give +30%.
TEXT.French: +5% à la production d’unités militaires terrestres par ferme effectivement exploitée par la ville productrice. Inclut les unités de siège ; exclut les unités civiles et les navires. Six fermes exploitées donnent +30%.
TEXT.German: +5% Produktion für militärische Landeinheiten für jeden Bauernhof, den eine Stadt bewirtschaftet.
TEXT.Italian: +5% alla produzione di unità militari terrestri per fattoria effettivamente lavorata dalla città produttrice. Include le unità d’assedio; esclude le unità civili e le navi. Sei fattorie lavorate danno +30%.
TEXT.Spanish: +5% a la producción de unidades militares terrestres por granja efectivamente trabajada por la ciudad productora. Incluye las unidades de asedio; excluye las unidades civiles y los barcos. Seis granjas trabajadas otorgan +30%.

TEXT.English: Units start with +5 experience.
TEXT.French: Units start with +5 experience.
TEXT.German: Einheiten starten mit +5 Erfahrung.
TEXT.Italian: Units start with +5 experience.
TEXT.Spanish: Units start with +5 experience.

TEXT.English: +25% unit production. Food surplus contributes to land military unit production.
TEXT.French: +25% unit production. Food surplus contributes to land military unit production.
TEXT.German: +25% Einheitenproduktion. Nahrungsüberschuss trägt zur Produktion militärischer Landeinheiten bei.
TEXT.Italian: +25% unit production. Food surplus contributes to land military unit production.
TEXT.Spanish: +25% unit production. Food surplus contributes to land military unit production.

TEXT.English: +1 culture from monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.French: +1 culture from monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.German: +1 Kultur durch Monumente, einschließlich einzigartiger Ersatzgebäude.
TEXT.Italian: +1 culture from monuments, including unique replacements.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 culture from monuments, including unique replacements.

TEXT.English: +1 happiness in cities with the state religion; +100% production for its missionaries and +25% production for its religious buildings.
TEXT.French: +1 bonheur dans les villes de la religion d’État ; +100% de production pour ses missionnaires et +25% pour ses bâtiments religieux.
TEXT.German: +1 Zufriedenheit in Städten mit Staatsreligion; +100% Produktion für Missionare und +25% Produktion für Gebäude der Staatsreligion.
TEXT.Italian: +1 felicità nelle città con la religione di Stato; +100% produzione per i suoi missionari e +25% per i suoi edifici religiosi.
TEXT.Spanish: +1 felicidad en ciudades con la religión estatal; +100% de producción para sus misioneros y +25% para sus edificios religiosos.

TEXT.English: +10% production in cities with the state religion; -1 happiness per non-state religion. Conquered cities are pacified by conversion.
TEXT.French: +10% de production dans les villes de la religion d’État ; -1 bonheur par autre religion. La conversion pacifie les villes conquises.
TEXT.German: +10% Produktion in Städten mit Staatsreligion; -1 Zufriedenheit je fremder Religion. Eroberte Städte werden durch Konvertierung befriedet.
TEXT.Italian: +10% produzione nelle città con la religione di Stato; -1 felicità per ogni altra religione. La conversione pacifica le città conquistate.
TEXT.Spanish: +10% de producción en ciudades con la religión estatal; -1 felicidad por cada otra religión. La conversión pacifica las ciudades conquistadas.

TEXT.English: No unhappiness from non-state religions and no different-religion diplomatic penalties involving your country. +2 relations toward you from countries with a different state religion, except State Atheism. +5 percentage points to incoming religion spread chances through trade routes.
TEXT.French: No unhappiness from non-state religions and no different-religion diplomatic penalties involving your country. +2 relations toward you from countries with a different state religion, except State Atheism. +5 points de pourcentage aux chances de propagation des religions vers vos villes par les routes commerciales.
TEXT.German: Keine Unzufriedenheit durch fremde Religionen und keine diplomatischen Religionsmali mit eurem Land. +2 Beziehungen zu euch bei Ländern mit anderer Staatsreligion, außer Staatsatheismus. +5 Prozentpunkte auf die Chance der Religionsverbreitung durch Handelswege in eigene Städte.
TEXT.Italian: No unhappiness from non-state religions and no different-religion diplomatic penalties involving your country. +2 relations toward you from countries with a different state religion, except State Atheism. +5 punti percentuali alla probabilità di diffusione delle religioni nelle proprie città tramite rotte commerciali.
TEXT.Spanish: No unhappiness from non-state religions and no different-religion diplomatic penalties involving your country. +2 relations toward you from countries with a different state religion, except State Atheism. +5 puntos porcentuales a la probabilidad de propagación religiosa a tus ciudades por rutas comerciales.

TEXT.English: +10% research and +10% production; -1 happiness in all cities. Religious buildings have no effects and religions cannot spread.
TEXT.French: +10% research and +10% production; -1 happiness in all cities. Religious buildings have no effects and religions cannot spread.
TEXT.German: +10% Forschung und +10% Produktion; -1 Zufriedenheit in allen Städten. Religiöse Gebäude wirken nicht und Religionen verbreiten sich nicht.
TEXT.Italian: +10% research and +10% production; -1 happiness in all cities. Religious buildings have no effects and religions cannot spread.
TEXT.Spanish: +10% research and +10% production; -1 happiness in all cities. Religious buildings have no effects and religions cannot spread.
